title: CanonicalChunkSchema
description: Schema for structure-aware canonical text chunks used in hybrid retrieval and RAG. Compatible with Adham's data governance pipeline.

chunk_id.description: Unique identifier for the chunk, e.g. doc_nice_acs_chest_pain_chunk_0

document_id.description: Foreign key to the parent document

block_index.description: Zero-indexed sequential position of this chunk within the document

section_path.description: Hierarchical breadcrumb of headers from document title to current subsection

heading.description: Immediate section heading for this chunk

text.description: Clean, structure-aware markdown text content of this chunk

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the chunk text content for integrity verification

source_locator.description: Exact locator formatted as filename#section_heading for provenance tracking

title.description: Document title retained for backwards compatibility with existing UI and agents

section.description: Section name retained for backwards compatibility with existing UI and agents

token_count.description: Approximate word or token count of the chunk

source_body.description: Issuing regulatory or clinical authority (e.g. NICE, GMC)

source_authority_note.description: Description of regulatory status or legal authority of the source

citation.description: Standard citation format for referencing this chunk in clinical and ethical decision-making

clinical_domain.description: Broad clinical specialty or governance domain (e.g. acute_physical_medicine, mental_health, ethics_professionalism)
